description: This Java source file defines the DetachedSensor class, which manages UI components for displaying and interacting with sensor data in a graphical interface. It includes creating and showing sensor gauge panels, mock voltage sliders for certain sensors, and persisting UI state.

classes.name: DetachedSensor
classes.description: A class representing a detachable user interface component for sensor visualization, allowing mock voltage control and position saving.

methods.name: DetachedSensor
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the DetachedSensor UI component with a specified sensor and width.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Initializes and constructs the UI components.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the sensor UI at the location of a mouse event.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Updates the UI when the sensor type changes.

methods.name: showMockControl
methods.description: Displays or hides mock voltage control based on sensor type and mode.

methods.name: isMockable
methods.description: Checks if the current sensor supports mock voltage simulation and if stimulation mode is active.

methods.name: createMockVoltageSlider
methods.description: Creates a slider component that simulates voltage levels for mock sensors.

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.description: Saves the UI component's position and size into a data node for persistence.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static method to instantiate a DetachedSensor from a data node.
